rows.ARS:
Dark red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Night Time
rows.Bloom: Dark red. Flowers dark black-red. Strong, old rose fragrance. 39 petals. Large, full (26-40 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed buds.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower or garden. Vigorous.
rows.Patents: United States - Patent No: PP 3,924 on 22 Jul 1976 VIEW USPTO PATENT
rows.Notes: Margaret Maclean emails she's noticed when the weather is really hot the color of the bloom is darker.
